code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    background, _ = counts.most_common(1)[0]
    other = next(value for value in counts if value != background)
    if counts[other] == 1:

    return [[0 if value == background else background for value in row] for row in grid]
